map.8拍分段规划器，按BPM和小节数生成舞蹈编排时间轴: 8-beat phrase planner that generates a dance timeline from BPM and bar count
map.「8拍分段规划器，按BPM和小节数生成舞蹈编排时间轴」按输入参数进行专业计算并输: "8-beat phrase planner that generates a dance timeline from BPM and bar count" is computed from the input parameters and returns the result.
map.每小节时长 = 拍号 × 60 ÷ BPM；分段时长 = 小节数 × 每小节时长: Duration per bar = time signature × 60 ÷ BPM; phrase duration = bars × duration per bar. You can customize each phrase name and movement description.
map.分段编排：按 8 拍生成时间轴，逐段标注动作名称，形成可执行的编舞骨架。: Phrase planning: generate a timeline of 8-beat phrases, label each with movement names, and form an executable choreography skeleton.
map.教学拆解：把整支舞拆成若干 8 拍段，逐段教学与复练，降低学习负荷。: Teaching breakdown: split a whole dance into several 8-beat phrases for teaching and rehearsal, reducing the learning load.
map.时长预估：累加各段时长得总时长，用于控场与节目单排期。: Duration estimate: sum phrase durations for the total, used for pacing control and program scheduling.
map.BPM 128、4/4 拍，单 8 拍段 3.75 秒；编排 16 段共约 60: BPM 128 in 4/4, one 8-beat phrase takes 3.75 s; choreographing 16 phrases gives about 60 s, plus 10 s for staging, so the total program length is about 70 s.
map.拍号怎么选？: How do I choose the time signature?
map.按所用音乐的拍号填写，影响每段秒数。: Fill in the time signature of the music you use; it affects the seconds per phrase.
map.能导出编舞结构吗？: Can I export the choreography structure?
map.支持导出分段名称与动作描述，便于教学留存。: Yes, you can export phrase names and movement descriptions for teaching records.
map.可以，段落可改名并补充动作描述，时间轴自动重算。: Yes. Phrases can be renamed and given movement descriptions, and the timeline recalculates automatically.
map.编舞时间线规划器，按BPM与拍号生成8拍分段时间轴，支持自定义段落名称与动作描述: The Choreography Timeline planner generates an 8-beat phrase timeline from BPM and time signature, supports custom phrase names and movement descriptions, and exports the choreography structure in one click.
